_about: What each listing is an alternative to, only where the project's own README, GitHub description or website says so. n: the product it replaces. paid: true when that product costs money (it then shows on the 'Free alternatives to tools you pay for' shelf). src: where the claim is. quote: the project's own words. note: a caveat the project itself gives. area: where it goes on the Free alternatives page (cli: replaces a built-in command, left off that page). tag: a word on its card instead of "Free". Leave a listing out rather than guess.

voicestudio.quote: VoiceStudio is the open-source, fully-local ElevenLabs alternative

photocraft.quote: an open-source, clean-room reimplementation of Adobe Photoshop
photocraft.note: Its README says it is not yet a Photoshop replacement for daily professional work.

rustdesk.quote: An open-source remote desktop application designed for self-hosting, as an alternative to TeamViewer.

localsend.quote: An open-source cross-platform alternative to AirDrop

posting.quote: Posting is an HTTP client, not unlike Postman and Insomnia.

glances.quote: A top/htop alternative for GNU/Linux, BSD, macOS and Windows operating systems.

fd.quote: A simple, fast and user-friendly alternative to 'find'

duf.quote: Disk Usage/Free Utility - a better 'df' alternative

jan.quote: Jan is an open source alternative to ChatGPT that runs 100% offline on your computer.

appflowy.quote: The Open Source Alternative To Notion

meetily.quote: Privacy-First AI Meeting Assistant | Otter.ai & Granola Alternative
meetily.note: Its Community Edition is free and open source; Meetily also sells a Pro plan.

yogurt.quote: A free, open-source alternative to Granola, Otter and Fireflies.

hob.quote: A free, open-source alternative to Claude and ChatGPT.

affine.quote: A privacy-focused, local-first, open-source, and ready-to-use alternative for Notion & Miro.

genoffice.quote: GenOffice is a free, open-source alternative to Microsoft Office for macOS, Windows and Linux.

noop.quote: Offline WHOOP companion — pair your strap over Bluetooth, keep all data on your own device. No cloud, no account, no subscription.
noop.note: You still need a WHOOP 4.0 or 5.0 strap. Its licence (PolyForm Noncommercial) allows personal use but not commercial use, so it isn't open source in the strict sense.

cap.quote: Cap is the open source alternative to Loom.

opencut.note: Being rewritten. Its README says the version at opencut.app is the one to use today.

anarlog.quote: anarlog is an open-source alternative to Granola.

openwhispr.quote: The open-source and free alternative to WisprFlow and Granola.

open-notebook.quote: An open source, privacy-focused alternative to Google's Notebook LM!

jellyfin.quote: It is an alternative to the proprietary Emby and Plex, to provide media from a dedicated server to end-user devices via multiple apps.

bruno.quote: Opensource IDE For Exploring and Testing API's (lightweight alternative to Postman/Insomnia)

twenty.quote: The open alternative to Salesforce, designed for AI.

plane.quote: Open-source Jira, Linear, Monday, and ClickUp alternative.

huly.quote: Huly — All-in-One Project Management Platform (alternative to Linear, Jira, Slack, Notion, Motion)

leantime.quote: A perfect alternative to ClickUp, Monday, or Asana

chatwoot.quote: The modern customer support platform, an open-source alternative to Intercom, Zendesk, Salesforce Service Cloud etc.

activepieces.quote: An open source replacement for Zapier

docmost.quote: It is an open-source alternative to Confluence and Notion.

bigcapital.quote: Independent financial accounting with intelligent reporting, alternative to Quickbooks, Xero, Wave.

hi-events.quote: alternative to Eventbrite, Tickettailor, Dice.fm and other ticketing platforms

coolify.quote: It is an alternative to Heroku, Netlify, and Vercel.

dokploy.quote: Open Source Alternative to Vercel, Netlify and Heroku.

tabby.quote: offering an open-source and on-premises alternative to GitHub Copilot
